calibration: 2022, notebook-5 calendar rule, 20/month, 240/yr, 240-min cooldown, no outcome labels

evaluation.alerts: pre-onset, in-progress, pre-peak and lead >= 30/60 min before onset, dev 2023-01..2026-04
evaluation.per_minute: notebook-18/21 decomposition (L1 label, event split); paired differences vs A from one shared 500 x 7-day block bootstrap

holdout_use: notebook-11 stored alerts only, re-scored under the nulls (post hoc, descriptive); no new model touches any holdout
label_use: peak and onset times enter only the 2021 training labels; features and alert rules are causal

labels.A_standard: positive if a 4% breach occurs 30-240 min later (notebook 16)
labels.B2_pre_onset_in_decline_negative: as B, but positive minutes at or after the onset are kept as negatives
labels.B_pre_onset: positive only if also before the 1% onset of that event; positive minutes at or after the onset are dropped from training
labels.C_pre_peak: positive only if also before the peak of that event; positive minutes at or after the peak are dropped from training

null_audit_rule: Dev M0 pre-onset warning is called robust to the budget constraint if p < 0.05 under the budget-preserving null; the Bitcoin holdout reading is called unchanged if its pre-onset p >= 0.05 under that null.

nulls.budget_preserving_regime: each alert, in random order, to a random minute of the same calendar month and the same 24h-RV decile, >= 240 min from its original and >= 240 min from every alert already placed; nearest decile if none fits; 64 candidates per decile; monthly counts are identical by construction
nulls.regime: each alert to a random minute of the same 24h-RV decile within +-30 days, >= 240 min away

prospective: B, B2 and C models and thresholds are frozen with SHA-256 hashes for a pre-registered test on data from November 2026 onward
reading_rule: Label X improves early warning for method m only if (i) within-regime pre-onset AUC (X minus A) is at least 0.02 and its paired 95% block-bootstrap interval lies above 0, and (ii) X has at least 0.5 more above-chance pre-onset catches per 100 alerts than A under the budget-preserving null. "Worse" if the interval in (i) lies below 0; otherwise "no material improvement". Reported for every m and X; nothing is selected.
title: Onset-aware training labels and a budget-preserving null (dev 2023-01..2026-04, exploratory)
